competition.note: Primarily early-down runner with some pass-blocking limitations; had 758 rush yds/6 TD on 159 carries in 2025. Note: ESPN's roster page lists his age as 26, but his birthdate (5/24/1999) computes to 27 as of Aug 2026.

notes: Vikings' RB room is Jones-Mason atop the chart, with Claiborne clearly RB3 as a rookie.

Claiborne is projected as a developmental receiving-specialist piece; one outlook projected only ~27.6 rushing attempts and 3.3 receptions for him in 2026, i.e. very limited early-season workload expected.

Neither Jones (durability concerns, 31) nor Mason (pass-block limitations) is a lock for a full workload, which is Claiborne's most realistic path to relevance, but that path is not imminent per current reporting.
